messages:
elaine-partners: Quick sync — prepping AWS/GCP/Azure listings for the upcoming customer pilot. Need owners on KMS, metering mapping, and final packaging/legal. Blocking items: KMS cross-account, marketplace SKU taxonomy, EULA telemetry clause, and metering export.

elaine-partners: Top-level asks:
- AWS/GCP/Azure KMS keys + trust role info
- Billing SKU -> marketplace metering mapping
- Final EULA snippet for telemetry + trial limits
- Packaging artifacts (logo, icon sizes, short/long descriptions)

toby-aws-eng: I can own AWS KMS and the IAM role for marketplace ingestion. Need the partner account ID and the deploy role ARN you want us to trust.

nik-infra: For GCP we'll provision a CMEK and a service account with roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter. For Azure we'll request a key in KeyVault and show the access policy.

elaine-partners: Partner account ID (for test tenant) = 987654321098. Suggested deploy role: arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/MarketplaceDeploy.

toby-aws-eng: Got it. We'll create the key and push a CloudFormation snippet. Example snippet for KMS: ```
resource "aws_kms_key" "marketplace" {
  description = "marketplace encryption key - redwood-inference"
  enable_key_rotation = true
}
```
I'll also attach a cross-account policy to allow the marketplace ingestion role to encrypt/decrypt.

sara-legal: Quick note on EULA: we need an explicit telemetry opt-out path and a data retention clause (30 days by default for logs, 90 days for aggregated usage). Also need to mention telemetry is used for billing/metering. I'll post a short draft in this thread.

michael-product: Packaging question: proposed SKU names: redwood-standard, redwood-dedicated, redwood-private-trial. We should avoid long prefixes. Also confirm trial SKU behavior (quota, duration).

elaine-partners: Prefer concise: "standard", "dedicated", "private" with a "-trial" suffix. Trial rules: 14 days, 5K token cap/day, 2 concurrent deployments. Can we implement those caps?

nik-infra: We can enforce token caps at the gateway level and track concurrency via our session store. Need to add a flag to the marketplace onboarding config: `trial_limits` with {tokens_per_day, concurrent}.

ops-bot: marketplace-ticket-4567 created: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/MARKET-4567 - owners assigned: toby-aws-eng, nik-infra, sara-legal.

toby-aws-eng: Metering dims we plan to emit: `instance_hours`, `token_count`, `response_time_ms`. AWS meter ingestion expects a JSON payload every hour. We'll map `token_count` -> marketplace usage dimension.

nik-infra: Implementation plan: CloudWatch metric filters -> metrics -> lambda to call vendor metering API. Need vendor metering API key and endpoint. Who provides that?

elaine-partners: Marketplace portal provides the endpoint and an API key during onboarding. I'll request them from the vendor and drop here once received.

sara-legal: KMS policy constraint: key must be non-exportable and rotation enabled. Confirming with compliance that rotation period can be 90 days. Also need to add jurisdiction clause for EU customers (keys should be in EU region).

michael-product: Docs: need short descriptions (1 line) + long description (200-300 words) and three screenshots. I can assemble copy if you give final SKU names and trial limits.

elaine-partners: Action items:
- toby-aws-eng: create AWS KMS + CFN snippet, add cross-account policy (owner)
- nik-infra: create GCP CMEK + Azure KeyVault plan (owner)
- sara-legal: post EULA telemetry draft + EU clause (owner)
- michael-product: draft packaging assets and short/long copy (owner)
- elaine-partners: request marketplace API key and provide partner account details to vendors

toby-aws-eng: I'll aim to have the CFN and IAM role policy by EOD PST.

nik-infra: I'll provision GCP CMEK in the dev project and share the service account email by tomorrow.

sara-legal: Posting the EULA snippet now: "We collect anonymous usage metrics for billing, product quality, and fraud prevention. Customers may opt out of non-essential telemetry; opting out may limit product features during trial." Please review.

michael-product: I'll start on screenshots and the 1-line. ETA tomorrow lunchtime.

elaine-partners: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the canonical onboarding checklist. Ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:
